- id: recipe-yubiotp-hmac-sha1-challenge-response
    status: manual
    confidence: medium
    migration_kind: member
    v1: OtpSession.ConfigureChallengeResponse(...).UseHmacSha1(...).Execute() / OtpSession.CalculateChallengeResponse(...).GetDataBytes()
    v2: HmacSha1SlotConfiguration with YubiOtpSession.PutConfigurationAsync(...) / YubiOtpSession.CalculateHmacSha1Async(...)
    evidence:
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Otp/OtpSession.cs
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Otp/Operations/ConfigureChallengeResponse.cs
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Otp/Operations/CalculateChallengeResponse.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiOtp/src/IYubiOtpSession.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiOtp/src/HmacSha1SlotConfiguration.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiOtp/examples/OtpTool/Commands/ChalRespCommand.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiOtp/examples/OtpTool/Commands/CalculateCommand.cs
    notes: Slot programming is persistent; v1 ShortPress/LongPress map semantically to Slot.One/Slot.Two. Use explicit OTP HID for the documented USB challenge recipe. Agree one challenge-length convention with the verifier (see src/YubiOtp/README.md); the SDK sends 64 bytes but does not know the slot mode. Review touch notifications, complete masked updates and both current/new access-code arguments. Clear caller-owned source buffers and returned response separately from configuration disposal.
    last_reviewed_commit: 5a82db9bce05addc0385162e9f085adbc2366c5b

- id: yubiotp-static-password-keyboard
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: member
    v1: OtpSession.ConfigureStaticPassword(slot).SetPassword(ReadOnlyMemory<char>).WithKeyboard(KeyboardLayout).Execute()
    v2: new StaticPasswordSlotConfiguration(string password, KeyboardLayout keyboardLayout)
    evidence:
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Otp/Operations/ConfigureStaticPassword.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiOtp/src/StaticPasswordSlotConfiguration.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/yubikit-gaps-remediation/ISA.md
    notes: The string/layout constructor restores the historical missing entry point. It validates characters before allocating translated scan codes and clears the intermediate after copying into the configuration; it cannot erase the immutable source string. The raw overload takes translated scan codes, not UTF-8. OtpTool currently makes that encoding mistake and ignores layout, so use the public constructor as the migration route. Library generation helpers and NDEF read-back remain absent.
    last_reviewed_commit: e042280ed7ec03a0250745ff3ff272680e5570b9

- id: yubiotp-yubico-otp-challenge-response
    status: manual
    confidence: medium
    migration_kind: member
    v1: OtpSession.ConfigureChallengeResponse(slot).UseYubiOtp(true).UseKey(...).Execute() / OtpSession.CalculateChallengeResponse(slot).UseYubiOtp(true).UseChallenge(...).GetDataBytes()
    v2: new YubicoOtpChallengeResponseSlotConfiguration(aesKey) with YubiOtpSession.PutConfigurationAsync(...) / YubiOtpSession.CalculateYubicoOtpAsync(slot, challenge, cancellationToken)
    evidence:
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Otp/Operations/ConfigureChallengeResponse.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiOtp/src/YubicoOtpChallengeResponseSlotConfiguration.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiOtp/src/IYubiOtpSession.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/yubikit-gaps-remediation/ISA.md
    notes: The restored AES configuration requires an exact 16-byte key; CalculateYubicoOtpAsync sends six challenge bytes and returns a caller-owned 16-byte encrypted Yubico ticket, not deterministic raw challenge encryption. The application verifies decrypted challenge, ticket CRC and replay policy. TOTP time/period/code conveniences are separate and remain absent. Review persistent slot effects, explicit OTP HID selection, touch notifications and current/new access-code behavior manually.
    last_reviewed_commit: e042280ed7ec03a0250745ff3ff272680e5570b9
